data.one_liner: Wraps libopus for Dart, providing encoding/decoding APIs and optional stream transformers.
data.what_it_does: It exposes libopus functionality via FFI, offering both low‑level bindings and a higher‑level Dart API for encoding PCM to Opus packets and decoding them back. The API includes simple and buffered encoders/decoders and stream transformers.
use_when: You need Opus audio encoding/decoding in a Flutter or Dart app
You want a Dart‑friendly API that handles memory management
You need Web support via web_ffi
avoid_when: You only need a pure Dart implementation without native code
You are targeting platforms without libopus binaries
strengths: Provides both low‑level bindings and high‑level API
Includes stream transformers for easy PCM stream handling
Clear separation of simple vs buffered encoders for performance tuning
weaknesses: Requires manual loading of libopus binaries
Memory must be manually freed to avoid leaks
No native build system, so distribution of binaries is manual
data.setup_notes: Download and ship libopus binaries for each target platform, load them with DynamicLibrary (or web_ffi on web), call initOpus(lib) before using the API. No build_runner needed.
